first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person walking along the bridge with their back to the camera, wearing a brown pointed wide-brimmed hat, with a long braid, and dressed in gray-green long sleeves, a dark vest, and a dark brown long skirt.

entities.name: Layered Rocky Hills
entities.identification: A gray-brown rocky hill with step-like rock strata behind the far end of the bridge.

entities.name: Blue Sky and White Clouds
entities.identification: The pale cyan-blue sky and large expanses of white clouds in the upper part of the image, brighter in the upper right.

entities.name: Tall Grass by the Bridge and Vegetation on the Grassy Slope
entities.identification: Continuous green clumps of grass at the far end of the bridge and on the slope on the right, interspersed with taller spike-like plants.

entities.name: Distant Flat-Topped Mountain
entities.identification: A mountain in the distant upper-left background with a relatively level top, softened by blue-gray haze.

entities.name: Gray-Blue Stone-Slab Bridge Deck
entities.identification: A long, narrow passage paved with gray-blue stone slabs between the stone railings on both sides, converging toward the far end.

entities.name: Reddish-Brown Stone Railings on Both Sides of the Bridge
entities.identification: Low stone railings with repeated arched openings on both sides of the bridge; the left side appears reddish-brown under the light, while the right side is darker.

entities.name: Dark Boulder on the Right
entities.identification: A large, angular dark-gray to nearly black rock at the top of the slope on the right, with a brighter rock face on the right side.

entities.name: Rocky Slope on the Right
entities.identification: A gray-green rocky slope descending steeply outside the right stone railing, with inclined bedding and cracks on its surface.

entities.name: Blue-Gray Water Surface on the Left
entities.identification: The blue-gray water surface outside the left stone railing and below the Canyon Rock Wall on the Left; a narrow strip is exposed beyond the top of the railing, and it is also partially visible behind some arched openings.

entities.name: Canyon Rock Wall on the Left
entities.identification: A towering rock wall behind the water surface on the left, fading into blue-gray haze.

entities.name: Tall Tree and Small Tree atop the Rocky Hill
entities.identification: A pair of one tall and one short tree atop the rocky hill, with the small tree on the image-left side of the tall tree.
